title: build validate <id> checks only the winner of that id; an invalid file elsewhere does not matter, and an unknown id is rejected
source: intended: docs/decisions.md (build validate: a tolerant check of every build of every layer, one line per file, problem lines, one summary line)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-13, build validate). With an id the command prints the winner of that id (its line, its problem lines) and the summary line counting that winner only. A valid id exits 0 even when another file of the project is invalid; an invalid winner exits 2 with its problem lines; an id no file has is a rejection, exit 2, one stderr line `JITSO REJECTED: unknown build "<id>"`, nothing on stdout. The oracle has no `build validate` (and the runner maps only `build list`): it answers `unknown command` on stderr with exit 2, so every expectation that needs the command's output FAILS on it.

stdout.regex:
(?m)^ok haiku-explorer repo jitso/builds/haiku-explorer\.yaml
checked 1 builds: 1 ok, 0 invalid$

(?m)^invalid broken repo jitso/builds/broken\.yaml
  model "gpt-9" is not in the allowlist
  effort "extreme" is not in the allowlist
checked 1 builds: 0 ok, 1 invalid$
